```{r}
# Load factors
alpha <- c(0.7,0.75,0.8,0.85,0.9)

# Chaining = 1 + alpha
chaining <- 1 + alpha

# Linear probing (successful)
lp_success <- 0.5 * (1 + 1/(1 - alpha))

# Linear probing (unsuccessful)
lp_unsuccess <- 0.5 * (1 + 1/((1 - alpha)^2))

# Create data frame
data <- data.frame(alpha, chaining, lp_success, lp_unsuccess)

data
```

```{r}
plot(alpha, chaining, type="o", pch=16, col="blue",
     ylim=c(0, max(lp_unsuccess)),
     xlab=expression(alpha),
     ylab="Expected Number of Probes",
     main="Expected Runtime vs Load Factor")

lines(alpha, lp_success, type="o", pch=16, col="darkgreen")
lines(alpha, lp_unsuccess, type="o", pch=16, col="red")

legend("topleft",
       legend=c("Chaining",
                "Linear Probing (Successful)",
                "Linear Probing (Unsuccessful)"),
       col=c("blue", "darkgreen", "red"),
       lty=1, pch=16)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Add method labels
chaining$Method <- "Chaining"
linear$Method <- "Linear Probing"

# Combine into one dataframe
data <- rbind(chaining, linear)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x=Load.Factor,
                 y=Avg.Probes.Unsuccessful.Search,
                 color=Method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title="Unsuccessful Search Performance",
       x="Load Factor (alpha)",
       y="Average Probes") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x=Load.Factor,
                 y=Avg.Probes.Successful.Search,
                 color=Method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title="Successful Search Performance",
       x="Load Factor (alpha)",
       y="Average Probes") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x=Load.Factor,
                 y=Time.Unsuccessful.Search,
                 color=Method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title="Unsuccessful Search Running Time",
       x="Load Factor (alpha)",
       y="Time (seconds)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
